## Checked the roadmap?

Some things are deliberately out of scope for v1 and listed under "Not in v1" in
the README: reverting hunks in the working tree, reviewing staged changes,
committing from hunk, watch mode, three-way merge, syntax highlighting. If yours
is one of those, say so — a real use case is exactly what moves it up.
